title: Crescent moon with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='moonGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF9C4'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFC107'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='cheek' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFAB91'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF8A65'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Crescent moon shape -->
  <path d='M62 10 
           C38 10, 18 28, 18 52 
           C18 76, 38 94, 62 94 
           C54 84, 48 70, 48 52 
           C48 34, 54 20, 62 10 Z'
        fill='url(#moonGlow)'/>

  <!-- Inner shadow edge to give crescent depth -->
  <path d='M60 12 
           C42 16, 26 32, 26 52 
           C26 72, 42 88, 60 92 
           C50 82, 44 68, 44 52 
           C44 36, 50 22, 60 12 Z'
        fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Left eye -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='48' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#5D4037'/>

  <!-- Right eye -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#5D4037'/>

  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='37.5' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='51.5' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M32 60 Q43 74 54 60' 
        fill='none' 
        stroke='#5D4037' 
        stroke-width='3' 
        stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Left cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='url(#cheek)' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Right cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='url(#cheek)' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Small star twinkle near the moon -->
  <path d='M78 20 L80 26 L86 26 L81 30 L83 36 L78 32 L73 36 L75 30 L70 26 L76 26 Z'
        fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- Tiny star -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='64' r='1.5' fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
